why: Fernández de Bobadilla and Pełka's paper 'Symplectic monodromy at radius zero and equimultiplicity of μ-constant families' (Annals of Mathematics, Vol. 200, Issue 1, July 2024) proves the multiplicity conjecture in families (constant Milnor number implies constant multiplicity); the arXiv preprint predates the snapshot but the peer-reviewed publication and public announcements (e.g. BCAM) are post-snapshot, and other cases (metric version, quasihomogeneous surfaces) saw further progress in Sept 2025.
